WIN2\SESSION\5094RS-QUES 73
Telephone exchanges
*241. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of new telephone
exchanges installed in Uttar Pradesh,
Orissa, Rajasthan, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh
and NER during the last three years,
district-wise and year-wise;
(b) the details of the telephone
exchanges proposed to be set up during
the years 2002-2003 and 2003-2004 in
these States, district-wise; and
(c) the steps taken by Government for
expansion of telephone exchanges in these
States?
Modernisation of employment
exchanges
*242. SHRI PRITHVIRAJ CHAVAN:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
any steps to modernise the employment
exchanges and to collect accurate and
reliable statistics on the rate of
unemployment; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Pension schemes for unorganised
workers
*243. SHRI DINA NATH MISHRA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering introduction of a Pension
scheme for workers of unorganised sector
with a view to provide necessary social
security to them;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether funds have been kept apart
for the purpose in the Tenth Five Year
Plan;
(d) whether a proposal for generation
of resources for funding of the scheme has
been finalised; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

74
WIN2\SESSION\5094RS-QUES 74
Supply of rice to BPL families
*244. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the news report captioned "Right to food
still a dream" which appeared in 'The
Hindu' dated the 24th October, 2002;
(b) if so, what steps would be taken to
provide rice to families Living Below the
Poverty Line as directed by the Supreme
Court;
(c) what action Government propose
to take so that price of the rice through
ration shop is fixed as per the purchasing
capacity of these families living in
extreme poverty;
(d) whether any action plan is proposed
to be formulated to help villagers in
various parts of the country who are
bracing themselves for extreme hunger in
months ahead due to crop failure; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Procurement of rice and paddy
*245. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any plan to procure
rice and paddy by FCI during the current
paddy harvesting season;
(b) if so, whether any support price has
been fixed for paddy in the current season;
and
(c) whether any policy has been
adopted for distribution of rice to different
States?
India's help to safeguard Iranian oil
tankers
*246. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Iran has sought India's
help to safeguard transiting oil tankers in
the Persian Gulf and the Indian Ocean;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto?
India's share in international IT
market
†*247. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether despite swift development
of the Indian information technology
industry the country's share in
international industrial market is only 1.6
per cent and the country depends mainly
on North-American market where 67 per
cent of software is exported from India;
and
(b) if so, the details of the measures
taken/proposed to be taken by
Government to increase the export of
Indian Software to the fast growing
markets of Germany, Japan, France and
other countries in order to reduce
dependence on North-American market?
Flexible labour laws for new
industries
*248. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of LABOUR
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated a plan for making flexible
labour laws for new industries;

363
Programmes for employment
generation
1651. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether KVIC has launched district
special employment programme and block
development programme in backward
districts of Andhra Pradesh for
employment generation;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how far these programmes have
succeeded in generating employment in
backward districts of the State?
Cluster development programme in
Andhra Pradesh
1652. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) what initiatives Government have
taken to provide more employment
opportunities in rural areas and to promote
rural industries in the country;
(b) the steps taken to improve village
industries in Andhra Pradesh;
(c) what is the cluster development
programme; and
(d) what assistance has been extended
under the cluster development programme
to the State?
Structural reforms in agro industries
1653. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of rural and agro
industries;
(b) to what extent the structural reforms
initiated in 1991 have affected growth of
the agro and rural industries;
(c) whether the reforms have
strengthened these industries;
(d) if so, in what manner; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
improve performance of these
industries?

364
WIN2\SESSION\5096RS 364
Economic package for cottage
industries
1654. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
effective action plan or economic package
for promotion and development of cottage
and small scale industries in different parts
of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the present status of such industries;
and
(d) what is Government's reaction
thereto?
Steps to promote ARIs
1655. SHRI P.G. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) what are the steps taken by
Government to promote agro and rural
industries after emergence of WTO policies;
and
(b) if so, the action plan worked out by
Government to keep pace with the world
market?
Separate policy for ARIs
†1656. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
formulations of a separate policy for
development of agro, rural and very small
industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the said policy would be
implemented?
Foreign investment in nuclear power
programme
1657. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India has expressed its
willingness to invite foreign investment in
its nuclear power programme;
(b) if so, whether certain countries have
shown interest in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Disposal of nuclear waste
1658. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) what is the present system of
disposal of nuclear waste; and
(b) whether the method followed by in
the country is as per the international
standards and the norms followed by the
developed countries?
Nuclear technology for health care
1659. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
proposal to develop nuclear technology for
health care and food securities;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when it would be implemented;
and
(d) what would be the cost of these
projects?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

365
WIN2\SESSION\5096RS 365
Threat posed by uranium radiation to
the lives of Adivasis in Meghalaya
1660. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the infection
of mysterious diseases caused by radiation
in villages situated around uranium rich
Domiasiyal area in Meghalaya is increasing
and the cases of TB and Asthma are
increasing in tribal population there
alongwith premature ageing and the
incidents of deaths; and
(b) if so, the details of the measures
taken/proposed to be taken for protecting
life and health of tribal population of the
area?

(a) whether it is a fact that STD
services were disrupt
